prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, industry, and whether you need strategy, creative, paid media, personalization, chatbots, data science, or full-stack implementation. I can, however, help you find the best fit.

Quick questions so I can recommend specific agencies:
- What’s your main goal? (e.g., improve ad performance, personalize email/website, automate media buying, build an AI chatbot, generate content)
- Company size and monthly/annual marketing budget?
- Timeline (pilot vs long-term engagement)?
- Any vertical (ecommerce, entertainment, B2B SaaS, healthcare, etc.) or tech constraints?

If you want a fast starting point, consider two categories and example names that operate in/serve LA:

1) Large networks with strong AI/data practices (good for enterprise needs, analytics + creative + scale)
- Accenture Interactive
- Deloitte Digital
- R/GA
- AKQA
- Merkle (Dentsu)
- Ogilvy / WPP agencies

2) AI-focused marketing platforms/partners (good for specialized AI-driven functions)
- Persado (AI messaging)
- Phrasee (AI subject lines and copy)
- Albert.ai (autonomous media buying)
- Other niche vendors for creative optimization, personalization, and chatbots

How to evaluate agencies (fast checklist)
- Relevant case studies and ROI for your vertical
- Clear scope: strategy, tech build, data integration, ongoing optimization
- Data ownership, privacy, and compliance
- Team: data scientists vs. marketing strategists vs. creative
- Pilot option, KPIs, and minimum commitment
- Pricing model (retainer, % of media, or performance)
- References and examples of measurable outcomes
- Tech compatibility with your stack (CDP, CRM, ad platforms)

Next step I can do for you
- Build a tailored top‑5 LA shortlist with pros/cons, estimated pricing, and outreach templates if you tell me the answers to the questions above — or I can draft a short RFP you can send to agencies.

Which option would you like?
